rlInt8_t hpfCutOffFreqEr [8U]
 The deviations of RX IFA HPF cutoff frequency from the ideally expected values
for all the enabled RX channels are reported here.
HPF_CUTOFF_FREQ_ERROR = 100*(Measured Cutoff Frequency /
Expected Cutoff Frequency) - 100,
for RX IF filter in the HPF region.
Byte numbers corresponding to measured cutoff frequency error
on different RX channels, in this field are here:
I channel Q channel
RX0 0 4
RX1 1 5
RX2 2 6
RX3 3 7
1 LSB = 1%, signed number
Applicable only for the enabled channels.
.

Detailed Description

This is the Monitoring report which RadarSS sends to the host, containing the measured RX IF filter attenuation values at the given IF frequencies. RadarSS sends this to host at the programmed periodicity or when failure occurs, as programmed by the configuration API SB. Event: RL_RF_AE_MON_RX_IF_STAGE_REPORT.
